prompt: A brick basement corridor seen from hip height through a very wide lens, iron pipes converging overhead, magenta and green light glowing at the far end. The singer stands nearest us, front-on, his face a good third of the frame high, mouth stretched on a shout, firelight clean across it. On the left a furnace door hangs open, bundles of banknotes burning in the fire. On a bench behind him, small and soft: a Black upright bass player of about 60, tall and white-haired; a slim woman drummer of about 35 with bobbed black hair; a tubby young Italian American trumpeter of about 25; a wiry fingerpicking guitarist of about 70, bald. All shout. No lettering, no black bars. Thanks.
